stories.title: Chester: Cyclist dies in Hoole Bridge collision as Toyota driver flees scene
stories.summary: A cyclist has died after a collision on Hoole Bridge in Chester in the early hours of Thursday, and the driver of a silver Toyota Yaris fled the scene on foot. stories.title: Four nights of overnight A494 slip closures coming to Ewloe in June
stories.summary: Traffic Wales has confirmed four consecutive nights of overnight slip road closures at Ewloe Interchange next month, running from Monday 15 June to Friday 19 June. stories.title: North Wales Police share Staffordshire force appeal for wanted man
stories.summary: North Wales Police are asking the public to help locate a 29-year-old man with links to north Wales and Merseyside who is wanted by Staffordshire Police. stories.title: Flintshire urged to use NHS 111 Wales as Bank Holiday weekend approaches
stories.summary: The Welsh Ambulance Services NHS Trust is asking people in Flintshire to think before dialling 999 this Bank Holiday weekend, after calls to NHS 111 Wales rose by 24% over the same weekend last year.
